tools.name: create_aot
tools.description: Create an array of table literal. body: A list of table literals, name: The name of the AoT (optional), parsed: Whether the AoT was parsed from a TOML document (optional). Example: create_aot([{"key": "value"}], "my_array") -> [{"key": "value"}].

tools.name: create_datetime
tools.description: Create a datetime literal. year: The year component, e.g. 2023. month: The month component, e.g. 12. day: The day component, e.g. 25. hour: The hour component, e.g. 14. minute: The minute component, e.g. 30. second: The second component, e.g. 45. microsecond: The microsecond component, e.g. 123456. tzinfo: Timezone info, e.g. None.
tools.direct_call: tomlkit.api.DateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, microsecond, tzinfo)

tools.name: create_integer
tools.description: Create an integer literal. value: The integer value for the literal, e.g. 42 -> 42. trivia: Trivia information for the integer literal, e.g. {'comment': 'an integer'} -> str. raw: The raw string representation of the integer, e.g. '0x2A' -> '0x2A'.

tools.name: create_single_key
tools.description: Create a single key. key: The key string for the SingleKey. key_type: The type of the key (Bare or Basic). separator: The separator between key and value. Example: create_single_key('name', 'Bare', ' = ') -> 'name'.

tools.name: create_trivia
tools.description: Create trivia information (metadata). indent: whitespace before a value, e.g. '  ' -> {'indent': '  '}. comment_ws: whitespace after a value but before comment, e.g. '  ' -> {'comment_ws': '  '}. comment: comment starting with #, e.g. '# note' -> {'comment': '# note'}. trail: trailing newline, e.g. '\n' -> {'trail': '\n'}.

tools.name: create_whitespace
tools.description: Create a whitespace literal. s: The whitespace string to wrap, fixed: Whether the whitespace is fixed and cannot be merged or discarded. Example: create_whitespace('   ', True) -> '<Whitespace '   '>'

tools.name: make_aot
tools.description:
Create an array of table.
    
    :Example:
    
    >>> doc = document()
    >>> aot = aot()
    >>> aot.append(item({'x': 1}))
    >>> doc.append('foo', aot)
    >>> print(doc.as_string())
    [[foo]]
    x = 1

tools.name: make_comment
tools.description: Create a comment item. string: The comment text to create, e.g. 'This is a comment' -> Comment object.

samples.string: This is a single line comment

tools.name: make_date
tools.description: Create a TOML date. raw: A date string in RFC 3339 format, e.g. '2023-01-01' -> '2023-01-01'.

tools.name: make_document
tools.description: Returns a new TOMLDocument instance.

tools.name: dump_to_string
tools.description:
Dumps a TOMLDocument into a string.
    
    Args:
        data: A TOML document or mapping to be dumped into a string
        sort_keys: Whether to sort keys in the output
    
    Returns:
        A string representation of the TOML document
        
    Example:
        >>> dump_to_string({"key": "value"}, sort_keys=True)
        'key = "value"'

tools.name: make_float_item
tools.description: Create an float item from a number or string. raw: A number or string to convert to a float item, e.g. '3.14' -> 3.14.

tools.name: make_key
tools.description:
Create a key from a string. When a list of string is given, it will create a dotted key.
    
    Args:
        k: A string or list of strings to create a key from
        
    Returns:
        A string representation of the key
        
    Example:
        >>> make_key('foo')
        'foo'
        >>> make_key(['bar', 'baz'])
        'bar.baz'

tools.name: parse_string
tools.description: Parses a string into a TOMLDocument. string: A TOML-formatted string to parse, e.g. 'a = 1' -> {'a': 1}.

tools.name: make_newline
tools.description: Create a newline item. -> a newline whitespace character

tools.name: parse_toml
tools.description:
Parses a string or bytes into a TOMLDocument.
    
    Args:
        string: A string or bytes containing TOML data to parse, e.g. 'name = "test"' -> {"name": "test"}
        
    Returns:
        A dictionary representation of the parsed TOML data
        
    Raises:
        ValueError: If the input string is not valid TOML format

tools.name: register_custom_encoder
tools.description:
Add a custom encoder, which should be a function that will be called if the value can't otherwise be converted.
    
    The encoder should return a TOMLKit item or raise a ``ConvertError``.
    
    Example::
    
        @register_custom_encoder
        def encode_custom_dict(obj, _parent=None, _sort_keys=False):
            if isinstance(obj, CustomDict):
                tbl = table()
                for key, value in obj.items():
                    # Pass along parameters when encoding nested values
                    tbl[key] = item(value, _parent=tbl, _sort_keys=_sort_keys)
                return tbl
            raise ConvertError("Not a CustomDict")
    
    Args:
        encoder_func: A custom encoder function that takes an object and returns a TOMLKit item or raises ConvertError
    
    Returns:
        The encoder function unchanged

encoder_func.name: encode_custom_dict
encode_custom_list
encode_custom_string
encode_custom_number

tools.name: make_string_item
tools.description:
Create a string item.
    
    Creates a TOML string item from the given raw string content.
    - raw: The raw string content to wrap in a TOML string item
    - literal: If true, creates a literal string (no escaping)
    - multiline: If true, creates a multiline string
    - escape: If false, disables escaping of special characters
    
    Example: make_string_item("hello world") -> '"hello world"'

tools.name: make_table
tools.description:
Create an empty table.
    
    :param is_super_table: if true, the table is a super table
    
    :Example:
    
    >>> doc = document()
    >>> foo = table(True)
    >>> bar = table()
    >>> bar.update({'x': 1})
    >>> foo.append('bar', bar)
    >>> doc.append('foo', foo)
    >>> print(doc.as_string())
    [foo.bar]
    x = 1

tools.name: unregister_encoder
tools.description: Unregister a custom encoder. encoder: The custom encoder to unregister, e.g. a callable that was previously registered.

tools.name: make_whitespace_from_string
tools.description: Create a whitespace from a string. src: the string to create whitespace from, e.g. '   ' -> '   '.

tools.name: merge_toml_dicts
tools.description: Merge two dictionaries, useful for combining TOML configuration data. dict1: The first dictionary to merge into. dict2: The second dictionary to merge from. Example: merge_toml_dicts({'a': 1}, {'b': 2}) -> None, modifies dict1 to {'a': 1, 'b': 2}.

tools.name: copy_table
tools.description: Create a copy of a TOML table. table: A TOML table to copy, e.g. a table from a parsed TOML document -> a new table with same content.
